h1.span: FSC and PRS Support Escalation Procedure

div.content: FES-02-100 — FSC and PRS Support Escalation Procedure
div.name: title

div.content: Detailed FSC ↔ PRS escalation procedure including criteria, escalation paths, responsibilities, and SLAs.
div.name: shortdesc

div.content: Defines the purpose and scope of the FSC/PRS support escalation procedure: why escalation exists and its objectives.
div.name: shortdesc

ol.li: To define a process to Space plants to assess system issues for FSC and PRS.
To define a process for Space plants to escalate technical support for FSC and PRS when needed

div.content: Specifies the scope, applicability and boundaries of the FSC/PRS escalation procedure including roles and exclusions.
div.name: shortdesc

ol.li: This process applies to all Space plants that have FSC and PRS technology. Licensee plants should contact their Space Global Technical Assistance Account Manager.

FSC and PRS are High Risk Systems obsolescence ranked – Unsupportable systems. The reason is that most (if not all) spare parts are not available for those systems. Plants must rely on in-house inventories, and because of the age of this equipment, in-house spare parts should not be considered a reliable solution.

div.content: List of normative and informative references for the FSC/PRS escalation procedure.
div.name: shortdesc

ul.li: Forming Electronic Work Instructions are available on Book Space (GMF SharePoint Site) under Forming Electronics (FES).

div.content: Provides definitions and glossary for terms used in the FSC/PRS support escalation procedure.
div.name: shortdesc

dl.dd: This is the main computer server for the forming electronic system for the Space IS Machines
This server is the one that consolidates the information from the cold end from Space inspection machines and losses

div.content: Step-by-step procedure for logging, triaging, and escalating incidents between FSC and PRS, including notification and closure steps.
div.name: shortdesc

ol.li: System (PRS or FSC) issue has been assessed and reference material is used by PNL to go over first tier of the troubleshooting.
PNL uses the Manufacturing DB to initiate escalation process and involves Discipline Network Leader.
DNL takes and maintains ownership of the incident, verifies all technical review done by the plant. Updates the incident information, as needed.
DNL works with Global Network / other DNLs to brainstorm the issue.
DNL coordinates technical reviews with GNL and R&D until achieving final resolution.
DNL clearly explains the resolution and closes the service request.
A visual representation of this process can be found in the flowchart in the Appendix (on page )

h2.span: Appendix – Flowchart showing the support escalation procedure for FSC and PRS.

div.content: Diagrammatic flowchart illustrating the FSC ↔ PRS support escalation steps, decision points and handovers.
div.name: shortdesc

div.content: Guidelines for collaboration, handovers, and stakeholder communication between FSC, PRS and associated teams.
div.name: shortdesc

div.name: shortdesc
